build_vocab_from_datasets: build source and target vocabularies from a list of datasets using VocabConfig and a Launcher
train_spm_model: train a SentencePiece model from a sampled corpus file and return a Vocab object
sample_and_train_spm: sample a training corpus and train an SPM model or load a pretrained vocabulary
review_build_vocab: review the build_vocab async function that coordinates source and target vocabulary training
refactor_train_spm: refactor the train_spm function to customize SentencePiece model prefix and training lines
